unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Good communication skills are key to success in life.
unit_vocabulary.memor_hook: 联想 "commute(通勤)" + "cation(假期)"，上班路上大家用手机交流。

unit_vocabulary.comparison: face to face vs side by side
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We need to talk face to face to solve this problem.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: face(脸)对face(脸)，面对面交流最真诚。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I sent a text message to tell him the news.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: text(文字) + message(信息) = 文字短信。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 手势；迹象；标志 v. 签(名)；签字

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The speaker gave a wonderful speech on communication.

unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: location(地点)的前缀，指本地的。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Thank you for the helpful speech on communication.

unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: pre(预先) + fer(拿) -> 预先拿定的主意，更喜欢。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: adj. 镇静的；沉着的 v. 使平静；使镇静

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 机会；可能性 adj. 意外的；偶然的

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Promise me you'll think about it seriously.

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We need to make a plan for our team training.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: train(火车/培养) + ing = 训练。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: adj. 担忧的；焦虑的；胆怯的

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Do you find it hard to have a conversation with a stranger?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: strange(奇怪的/陌生的) + er = 陌生人。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 指点；实用的提示；尖端 v. 倾斜
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Here are some tips for making better conversations.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 笔尖(tip)给你的实用小贴士(tip)。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: adv. 认真地；仔细地；小心地

unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: careful(认真的) + ly = 认真地。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Show interest in others when they speak.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: show(展示) + interest(兴趣) + in(在……方面)。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: If you are a good listener, you will find good points to ask about.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: listen(听) + er(人) = 听众。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 观点；重点 v. 指向；瞄准

unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 手指一点(point)，指出核心观点(point)。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: They will surely be happy to continue the conversation.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: sure(确定的) + ly(副词) = 必定。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: They will surely be happy to continue the conversation.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: con + tinue(连续)，不断继续。

unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: im(否定前缀) + polite(礼貌的) = 不礼貌的。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Don't ask about other people's personal information.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: person(人) + al(形容词后缀) = 个人的。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: If you don't agree with others, don't argue with them.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: argue(争吵) + with(和……) = 与某人争吵。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: phrase 换话题；开始做(别的事)

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Be honest and sincere when talking to others.

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: People can find out you are not telling the truth.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 找(find)到外面(out)去，真相大白。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: v. 付费；交纳 n. 工资；薪水

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Pay attention to your body language.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: at + tend(倾向于) + ion = 集中注意力。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Pay attention to your teacher in class.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 付出(pay)注意力(attention)。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Stand up straight, smile, and be yourself.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 做(be)你自己(yourself)，展现本色。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: v. 提供；主动提出 n. 主动提议

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Do you think the tips are reasonable?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: reason(理由) + able(能……的) = 有道理的，合理的。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: adj. 社会的；社交的 n. 联谊会

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 媒介；手段 adj. 中等的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: English is an important medium of communication.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 介于(mid)中间的媒介。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Many people communicate by social media.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: social(社交的) + media(媒体)。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: It is easier to build trust and develop stronger relationships.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 特拉斯(trust)值得信任。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: This can keep us away from misunderstandings.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 保持(keep)在远处(away from)。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Good communication can keep us away from misunderstandings.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: mis(错误) + understanding(理解) = 误解。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 公开活动；重要事情
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We would like to invite you to give a speech at our Education Talk event.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: e(出) + vent(风/出口)，重大的事件轰动出门。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: adj. 开篇的；开始的 n. 开始

unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: open(打开) + ing = 开幕的/开头的。

unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: close(关闭) + ing = 结尾的。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 句子；判决 v. 判决

unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: send(发送) + tence -> 把词语送在一起组成句子。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 日期；日子；约会 v. 确定年代

unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 带着(da)他(te)去约会、定日期。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Yours sincerely, Tom.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: sincere(真诚的) + ly(副词后缀)。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The event will take place at 9 a.m. on 10th January.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 占据(take)地方(place)，即活动发生、举行。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 费用；价钱；代价 v. 价格为

unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 考死(cost)人的高昂费用。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Students will benefit a lot from the speech.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 从……中获得好处。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We are looking forward to your reply.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: re(再次) + ply(折叠/回应)，再次回信。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 荣幸；尊敬 v. 给……荣誉

unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: h不发音，感到荣幸(honour)。
